description: Graha Maitri (Rasyadhipati / lord-friendship) koota — mental and psychological compatibility, from the natural (Naisargika) friendship between the lords of the two Moon rashis.

planet_relationships._comment: Naisargika (natural, permanent) relationship of each planet TOWARD every other planet. relation is directional per planet-row; the compound score below combines both directions. Nodes (Rahu/Ketu) are not rashi lords in this scheme and are omitted.

scoring.rule: Let a = relation(groomLord -> brideLord) and b = relation(brideLord -> groomLord). Combine the unordered pair {a,b} via compound_table. If groomLord == brideLord, treat as friend-friend -> 5.

notes: Planet natural relationships follow the BPHS-standard Naisargika table.

The compound table encodes all six mutual-relationship outcomes including neutral-neutral = 3 (max is still 5). Some schools/tables collapse or relabel the middle bands; review_required to confirm the chosen authority's exact points.
This koota uses only natural (permanent) friendship, not temporary (Tatkalika) or five-fold (Panchadha) compound relationship.
